desc: Ideation: identify the 3D monotone grid, safe truncation to M = min(N, K), and candidate approaches.
Implement the full Python solution: fast input, sort A/B/C in nonincreasing order, truncate to M, and run a unique-parent best-first heap search.
Use packed heap keys (diff << 3b | id) and incremental coordinate deltas to compute child values efficiently.
Pop exactly K times, print the K-th largest value, and handle edge cases (K=1, K=M^3, N=1, duplicates, large integers).
Verify the implementation on the three sample inputs; all public samples passed.
